Hymn 81: Press Forward, Saints
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Vanja Y. Watkins

This is hymn number 81 titled "Press Forward, Saints" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Vanja Y. Watkins and the lyrics were written by Marvin K. Gardner.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
